zh.name: 冥魂渡者，死龙残躯，玻吕刻斯
zh.desc: 冥河中沉眠的死龙，受炼成召引再度苏醒，化成槁骨腐肉的模样。\n它曾是「死亡」的泰坦，逆溯冥河向上，离开乌有之界于现世搁浅。它曾随冥河潮汐涌上大地，为翁法罗斯的万事万物烙上命定的终局。那些将死的，或已死的存在，皆会因它的归来感受到灵魂深处的颤栗。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方单体造成量子属性伤害，对高于一定生命值百分比的目标，该伤害会转化为量子属性<u>【衰亡伤害】</u>。

401403002.name: 衰亡伤害
401403002.desc: 造成无法被护盾抵消、不可分摊的固定伤害。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成大量量子属性伤害，伤害由我方全体单位<u>平均分摊</u>。对高于一定生命值百分比的目标，该伤害会转化为量子属性<u>【衰亡伤害】</u>。

401301001.name: 平均分摊
401301001.desc: 本次攻击结算前的伤害和负面效果由所有受击目标平均承受。

401403002.name: 衰亡伤害
401403002.desc: 造成无法被护盾抵消、不可分摊的固定伤害。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对随机我方3个目标造成量子属性<u>【衰亡伤害】</u>。

401403002.name: 衰亡伤害
401403002.desc: 造成无法被护盾抵消、不可分摊的固定伤害。

skill_list.skill_desc: 使【哀悯长臂】得到强化，并使其行动提前，持续3回合。
进入<u>【死亡的芬芳】</u>状态，对我方全体角色造成大量量子属性<u>【衰亡伤害】</u>，该伤害<u>【不致命】</u>，同时使我方全体角色陷入<u>【沉沦于长眠】</u>状态。在二阶段，还会使自身下次行动前，韧性无法被削减并免疫来自我方目标造成的行动延后效果。

401403001.name: 不致命
401403001.desc: 目标受到伤害时，若目标生命值不足，则会将生命值降低至1点。

401403002.name: 衰亡伤害
401403002.desc: 造成无法被护盾抵消、不可分摊的固定伤害。

401403003.name: 死亡的芬芳
401403003.desc: 每回合结束时都会提高自身速度，【玻吕刻斯】或【哀悯长臂】受到攻击时可削减【濒死梦泡】并回复我方生命值，【濒死梦泡】完全耗尽时解除该状态。

401403004.name: 沉沦于长眠
401403004.desc: 该目标对敌方目标造成伤害时，敌方目标受到的伤害降低，我方目标恢复至一定生命值可解除此状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成量子属性<u>【衰亡伤害】</u>。对处于<u>【沉沦于长眠】</u>状态的目标造成额外的量子属性<u>【衰亡伤害】</u>，使其行动延后并大概率陷入纠缠状态。

401403002.name: 衰亡伤害
401403002.desc: 造成无法被护盾抵消、不可分摊的固定伤害。

401403004.name: 沉沦于长眠
401403004.desc: 该目标对敌方目标造成伤害时，敌方目标受到的伤害降低，我方目标恢复至一定生命值可解除此状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 使自身和【哀悯长臂】初始受到的伤害降低，我方目标生命值降低时会积累【濒死梦泡】，当【濒死梦泡】达到上限时，使自身行动提前，下一次行动会进入<u>【死亡的芬芳】</u>状态。在该状态下，移除自身和【哀悯长臂】的受到伤害降低状态。解除<u>【死亡的芬芳】</u>状态时，自身受到伤害并回复我方目标生命值。

401403003.name: 死亡的芬芳
401403003.desc: 每回合结束时都会提高自身速度，【玻吕刻斯】或【哀悯长臂】受到攻击时可削减【濒死梦泡】并回复我方生命值，【濒死梦泡】完全耗尽时解除该状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 【玻吕刻斯】或【哀悯长臂】的技能击中我方目标时，会为我方目标施加不可解除的特殊持续伤害状态，该状态下目标当前生命值百分比越高受到的伤害越高，该伤害<u>【不致命】</u>。

en.name: Pollux, Netherwing Husk, Ferry of Souls
en.desc: Netherwing, slumbering dormant in the River of Souls, has been reawakened by an alchemical summoning and morphed into a thing of rot and decay.\nIt once was the Death Titan, swimming upstream in the River of Souls' currents, leaving the realm of non-existence and stranded in the mortal world. Once, they followed the tides of the River of Souls to drown the living lands, branding all things in Amphoreus with a fated end. All the existences that will die or have died will feel a shudder in the depths of their souls with the dragon's return.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Quantum DMG to one target. This DMG converts to Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" against targets with HP above a certain percentage.

401403002.name: Atrophy DMG
401403002.desc: Deals a fixed amount of DMG that cannot be offset by Shields or distributed.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets. The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among all target units. Against targets with HP above a certain percentage, this DMG converts to Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>."

401301001.name: Even Distribution
401301001.desc: The DMG and debuff before this attack's finalization is received evenly by all targets that are hit.

401403002.name: Atrophy DMG
401403002.desc: Deals a fixed amount of DMG that cannot be offset by Shields or distributed.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to 3 random targets.

401403002.name: Atrophy DMG
401403002.desc: Deals a fixed amount of DMG that cannot be offset by Shields or distributed.

skill_list.skill_desc: Causes "The Long Arms of Sorrow" to be enhanced and advances its action, lasting for 3 turns.

Enters the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state and deals massive Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to all target characters. This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>" and inflicts all target characters with <u>"Indulging Slumber."</u> In the second phase and before this unit's next action, its Toughness cannot be reduced, and it is immune to action delay effects caused by targets.

401403001.name: Non-fatal
401403001.desc: When the target receives DMG, if their HP is insufficient, reduces their HP to 1.

401403002.name: Atrophy DMG
401403002.desc: Deals a fixed amount of DMG that cannot be offset by Shields or distributed.

401403003.name: Fragrance of Death
401403003.desc: This unit's SPD increases at the end of every turn. When "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" is attacked, reduce "Desperate Bubble" and heal targets. When "Desperate Bubble" is completely consumed, dispel this state.

401403004.name: Indulging Slumber
401403004.desc: When this target deals DMG to enemy targets, decreases DMG received by enemy targets. Restore HP to an ally target until it reaches a certain amount to dispel this effect.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to all targets. Deals additional Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to targets in the <u>"Indulging Slumber"</u> state, delaying their action with a high chance of inflicting Entanglement.

401403002.name: Atrophy DMG
401403002.desc: Deals a fixed amount of DMG that cannot be offset by Shields or distributed.

401403004.name: Indulging Slumber
401403004.desc: When this target deals DMG to enemy targets, decreases DMG received by enemy targets. Restore HP to an ally target until it reaches a certain amount to dispel this effect.

skill_list.skill_name: Inky Fog of a Near-Death Dream
skill_list.skill_desc: Decreases the initial DMG this unit and "The Long Arms of Sorrow" receive. When targets lose HP, they accumulate "Desperate Bubble." When "Desperate Bubble" reaches the limit, advances this unit's action and enters the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state in its next turn. Under that state, removes this unit's and "The Long Arms of Sorrow"'s DMG Reduction state. When <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> is dispelled, this unit will take DMG and restore targets' HP.

401403003.name: Fragrance of Death
401403003.desc: This unit's SPD increases at the end of every turn. When "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" is attacked, reduce "Desperate Bubble" and heal targets. When "Desperate Bubble" is completely consumed, dispel this state.

skill_list.skill_name: Because I Could Not Stop For Death
skill_list.skill_desc: When "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" hits a target with an ability, applies a special Unremovable DoT DMG state to the target. While under this state, the higher the target's HP percentage is, the more DMG they take. This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>."

401403001.desc: When the target receives DMG, if their HP is insufficient, reduces their HP to 1.

Under that state, removes this unit's and "The Long Arms of Sorrow"'s DMG Reduction state. When <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> is dispelled, this unit will take DMG and restore targets' HP.

401403003.name: Fragrance of Death
401403003.desc: This unit's SPD increases at the end of every turn. When "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" is attacked, reduce "Desperate Bubble" and heal targets. When "Desperate Bubble" is completely consumed, dispel this state.

skill_list.skill_name: Because I Could Not Stop For Death
skill_list.skill_desc: When "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" hits a target with an ability, applies a special Unremovable DoT DMG state to the target. While under this state, the higher the target's HP percentage is, the more DMG they take. This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>."

401403001.name: Non-fatal
401403001.desc: When the target receives DMG, if their HP is insufficient, reduces their HP to 1.
